lessons.title: Practice Pagination Params
lessons.description: Implement page_params(page, page_size) returning limit/offset. The test checks that page_params(3, 10) equals {'limit': 10, 'offset': 20}.
learning_objectives: This step computes the offset for a page, using page and 1.
lessons.solution_code:
def page_params(page, page_size):
    return {'limit': page_size, 'offset': (page - 1) * page_size}

source.name: FastAPI docs — Query params — pagination with 'skip=0 and limit=10'

lessons.title: Filter Client Collection
lessons.description: Implement filter_items(items, **criteria) keeping dicts matching all criteria. The test checks that filter_items(items, ok=True) equals [{'id': 1, 'ok': True}].
learning_objectives: This step counts the rows that are on, using rows holding id.
lessons.solution_code:
def filter_items(items, **criteria):
    return [it for it in items if all(it.get(k) == v for k, v in criteria.items())]

tests.name: test_filter_items

source.name: Python docs — 5.1.3. List Comprehensions — filtering with conditions

lessons.title: Practice Idempotent Key
lessons.description: Implement idempotency_key(method, path, body) as method|path|body_or_empty. The test checks that idempotency_key('post', '/x', None) equals 'POST|/x|'.
learning_objectives: This step skips a key that was already seen, using seen holding kelp.
lessons.solution_code:
def idempotency_key(method, path, body):
    return method.upper() + '|' + path + '|' + (body or '')

source.name: MDN — Glossary: Idempotent — 'the intended effect ... of making a single request is the same as the effect of making several identical requests'
